leadText: Volume 7 is the seventh volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 7 is the seventh volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
La bourgeoise entêtée (« The stubborn bourgeois »)
Duel au sommet (1) (« The showdown 1 »)
Duel au sommet (2) (« The showdown 2 »)
Les origines de Kikui (« The origins of Gigi »)
Plongée dans la brume des rêves (« Diving in the Dream Mist »)
Rattrapage (« Caught again »)
Le Pokémon inconnu (« The unknown Pokémon »)
